crossRefs.note: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that…
For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because…

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
translations.bsb: Then I went to the governors west of the Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.
translations.kjv: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen
translations.asv: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent with me captains of the army and horsemen.
